claim_type: disproof by capped extremal witness (probabilistic-existential per parameter)
limitations: Probabilistic-existential per r=\(3^k\) (existence certified by failure majorant M(r)<1, no derandomized construction); defeats the \(N^{1/4}\) cap but does not characterize the optimal exponent under stronger caps; variance majorant and violation thresholds are sufficient but not optimized.
provenance: Previously published finding; fresh independent scientific assessment completed.
record_title: Disproof of the line-capped point-plane incidence bound \(N^{3/2-\delta}\) in \(\mathbb{F}_q^3\) by thinned-subfield witnesses
